sources.ids: Editor model choices for AI-specific blocks (2026-10-17)

purpose: Authoring and testing convenience, not a validator allowlist. Models retire every few months; check the wiki for current information.
guidance: Use id in selectedAIProfiles. IDs identify profiles, not capability rankings. Ask which profile the user plays on before adding profile-specific guidance; use only documented or user-reported quirks, and preserve unknown historical IDs. Retired IDs marked idSource 'derived from name' are not confirmed export values.

profiles.name: Dolphin
profiles.notes: Picker: quick, good instruction following, recommended.

profiles.name: Puma
profiles.notes: Picker: all-rounder, alternative to Dolphin.
